QuestInfo.0:
#e<Smash the Elunarium Deposits> Event#n

#bEvent Period#k
TKTKTK QRQRQR - TKTKTK QRQRQR

#bEvent Details#k
#b#p9400426##k says that #bElunarium Deposits in are growing in the towns of Maple World every 20 minutes#k.
